articles.title: Meta may ditch the idea of a cloud business for Muse. We think that’s a good trade
articles.summary: Shares struggled for much of the year as the Facebook and Instagram parent poured increasingly large sums into AI infrastructure without giving Wall Street enough evidence of how those investments would generate new revenue. The next year may still be dominated by AI spending rather than AI revenue, but we'd much rather see Meta use its computing power to build its own next growth engine than rent it out to someone else.

articles.title: What Marvell's rosy long-term guidance means for our AI chip stocks
articles.summary: The news sent shares of other stocks that power and electrify AI data centers higher, including GE Vernova and Eaton . Marvell Technology shares rose over 6% on Tuesday in reaction to upbeat near-term and long-term guidance at its investor day. The company also sees strong growth in its custom chip business, which counts Amazon and Alphabet among its major customers.

articles.title: Meta joins with group of companies to tame ‘chaos’ of doing business with AI bots
articles.summary: A month after Meta's launch of Muse, the personal agent that quickly turned into a viral sensation, a group of companies is coming together to try to simplify the process of bringing the technology into the business world. Meta, Walmart, Stripe and a handful of other companies are publishing what they're calling a "personal agent protocol." It's an open standard meant to dictate how artificial intelligence agents can interact with businesses.

articles.title: Boomers' dividend stocks take beating as bond yields rise, with retirement income on the line
articles.summary: Dividend stocks like utilities are being pummeled amid bond market chaos and the rise of the 10-year U.S. So investors might want to look more closely at funds that seek dividend growth versus those that are more focused on high yield. For older clients, this means focusing on a broader investment universe, including growth stocks and international, with some degree of dividend stocks and international stocks to supplement.

articles.title: Salesforce shares sit at the epicenter of AI confusion. Here's how to trade it
articles.summary: If ever there was a stock that personified the promise and peril of the AI trade, it's Salesforce. The stock bottomed in late June, down more than 40% from the start of the year on fears that AI agents would make traditional software subscriptions obsolete. Like many other legacy SaaS names, Salesforce has reported strong financials, but many investors remain unconvinced the business can grow through an AI driven overhaul of enterprise software.
